title: Bloodline Truth
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji hadn't yet recovered from the bloodline shock, a familiar yet strange voice rang out in his mind—it was Chen Ling, speaking to him voluntarily for the first time.

text.content: A savage wind howled past the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. The moment Chen Nian's figure appeared before the crowd, time seemed to freeze. In her hands she cradled an ancient scroll emanating a faint ghostly glow, its flowing patterns identical to those on the Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest. His long-lost sister had finally returned, yet she carried a secret that could overturn the entire cultivation world's understanding.

Chen Nian's voice was soft, yet it clearly reached every ear in the noisy hall. She slowly unrolled the scroll in her hands—it was a list, a record documenting the origins of that catastrophe ten thousand years ago. And at the very top of the list, three names were written in bold: Chen Family Ancestor, Su Family Ancestor, and the First Observer of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

Su Qingyao's voice trembled with disbelief. She snatched the list, her gaze firmly locked on that name—Su Family Ancestor, one of the candidate Observers for the Tianji Record ten thousand years ago, ranked alongside Chen Family Ancestor as an experimental product of the first Observer. The so-called bloodline inheritance was merely an afterthought of that forbidden experiment ten millennia ago.

dialogue.content: So, the so-called fate entanglement between you and me was nothing more than a laboratory designation number?

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it pierced Su Qingyao's heart like a blade. A hint of mockery even curled at the corner of his lips, but his clenched fists betrayed his current fury. Ten thousand years of scheming, only to make them experimental products as chess pieces. The so-called Heavenly Will, the so-called favored one of destiny, were merely tools for that eye to observe experimental data.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji felt the power surging through his bloodline—that was memory seared into his genes ten thousand years ago. Facing this earth-shaking truth, how would he choose?

choices.description: Since the bloodline is an experimental product, then walk this path to its extreme, and use their rules to devour them.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the Full Potential of the Bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Complete Assimilation by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the power dormant in his bloodline for ten thousand years awaken. It was a vast ocean of information that slammed against his divine sense. Memories from ten millennia ago flashed by like a carousel—the First Observer's mad experiments, the birth of two clans, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' layout... Everything had its answer.

choices.description: Damn all experimental products and Observer's chess pieces! I was never anyone's tool!
choices.visible_cost: Bloodline Power Cannot Be Fully Utilized
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Independent Will, Break Free from the Chains of Fate
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Direct Annihilation by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, an unprecedented light blazing in his pupils. He slapped the list, shattering it into powder. What did ten thousand years of scheming matter? Chen Ji never played by the rules. Since they were made into chess pieces, he would overturn the entire board!

choices.description: Neither accept nor challenge, but create a fourth possibility—transcending the binary opposition between Observer and observed.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Authority to Rewrite the Tianji Record Itself
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Inciting Full-scale Siege by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Suddenly, Chen Ji laughed. That smile carried the clarity of one who had seen through everything. He slowly spoke, his voice echoing through the hall: Observers created the rules of observation and being observed, yet never considered—there exists a third kind of being, one who is simultaneously the Observer, the observed, and the variable transcending all this. The moment his words fell, the fragment on his chest quivered violently.

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现了超越命运的决心

text.content: At this moment, a faint yet clear voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind, creating the first true resonance with his consciousness. Chen Ling, the twin of destiny dormant deep in his bloodline, expressed her existence voluntarily for the first time. Countless images surged like a tide—those were the essence of the fourth possibility, the ultimate answer transcending Observer and observed.

dialogue.content: You think transcending can let you escape? For ten thousand years, every existence that attempted to transcend has ultimately become part of me.

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice came from the void, carrying ancient arrogance and disdain. It never concealed its calculations, for to such a being, all resistance was merely an interesting fluctuation in experimental data. Yet this time, Chen Ji sensed something different—he was no longer alone. Chen Ling in his bloodline stood on the same front as him for the first time.

dialogue.content: Is that so? Then let's see if your eye is faster or my blade.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried unprecedented sharpness. He slowly raised his hand, and in his palm gathered light never before displayed—that was an entirely new power fusing bloodline strength with the Tianji Record Fragment. In ten thousand years, no one had ever merged these two forces, because no one had ever possessed both simultaneously. Yet he, Chen Ji, this disciple everyone regarded as worthless, had done it.

Su Qingyao watched the light in Chen Ji's hand, complex emotions flickering in her eyes. She finally understood why the Tianji Record had chosen Chen Ji, and why it had passed over her—it wasn't that she wasn't excellent enough, but that Chen Ji's bloodline inherently contained the core fragment of the First Observer. He was the fusion of Observer and observed, the most critical chess piece on this board, and the only one who could overturn it.

choice.prompt: Bloodline power churned within Chen Ji, and he felt gazes from all directions. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets awaited his choice, while Chen Ling within him was calling to him.

choices.description: Her fate has been entangled with yours for ten thousand years. Since the truth has been revealed, let her stand behind you.
choices.risk_hint: May Not Be Able to Fully Confront the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, a trace of tenderness flickering in his eyes. He reached out and took her wrist, pulling her to his side. Since the experiment ten thousand years ago bound their fates together, there was no reason to escape anymore. Su Qingyao's body trembled slightly, yet she didn't resist, letting his power flow into her body.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择与苏青瑶共同面对命运

choices.description: Taken away by the Holy Sect after being missing for years, she is the true victim of all this.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets May Use Chen Nian as Leverage

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Chen Nian, this sister who had been missing for many years. His gaze softened, and he gently reached out to stroke her head. Nian'er, all these years you've had it so hard. Chen Nian's tears burst forth, yet she stubbornly shook her head. Brother, I'm not suffering. As long as I can find you, everything is worth it. The two bloodline powers intersected in the air, erupting in dazzling light.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择与妹妹陈念并肩作战

text.content: Chen Ling's voice sounded again, clearer this time, carrying unprecedented determination. Brother, I have been waiting for this day. Ten thousand years ago, we were separated, implanted into different bodies, forced to become opposites of each other. But our essence has never changed—we are the same existence, merely two halves forcibly split. Now, it is time to become one again.

dialogue.content: After merging, will I still be me?

text.content: This was the first time Chen Ji showed hesitation before the crowd. Su Qingyao and Chen Nian both watched him nervously, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was awaiting his answer. Merging meant abandoning existing identity, meant becoming an entirely new existence. But if they didn't merge, they could never truly transcend this game. Chen Ling was silent for a moment, then softly said: You will be more complete than me, because you have everything I lack—hatred, obsession, and those people you want to protect.

choice.prompt: Blood burned, Chen Ling waited, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets coldly observed. At this moment, Chen Ji had to make the final choice.

choices.description: Become the complete Observer, possessing the power to rewrite the Tianji Record itself.
choices.visible_reward: Become an Existence Transcending the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He slowly closed his eyes, letting the bloodline power guide him toward Chen Ling. Two consciousnesses met in the void—one that had endured ten thousand years of tempering, and one that had slumbered for a millennium waiting to awaken. The moment they touched, the entire Tianqing Sect quivered, as if some ancient existence was awakening.

choices.description: Do not merge, fight separately, but your fates are intertwined—that is your special quality.
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Being Defeated One by One

text.content: No. Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried unshakeable determination. I don't need to merge to transcend you, because we were always one. Separation is not weakening, but a better way to observe this world. He gazed into the void, as if confronting the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Observers created observation rules, yet forgot the most important point—the observed can also look back upon themselves.

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice sounded again, this time carrying a hint of unprecedented solemnity: You think this is a choice? This is merely the fourth possibility I set. The Observer's game has never had true free will. Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt an intangible pressure descending—that was a gaze from higher dimensions, power transcending everything.

dialogue.content: Whatever you choose is within my anticipation. This is the Observer's destiny, and you can never escape.

text.content: Yet Chen Ji laughed. That smile carried the clarity of one who had seen through everything. He slowly spoke, his voice echoing through the hall, carrying unprecedented confidence: You say this is your fourth possibility? Have you ever considered a fifth possibility—making the Observer itself the object of observation? The moment his words fell, the fragment on his chest quivered violently, and unprecedented light burst forth from it.

This moment, the entire cultivation world trembled. Countless reclusive old monsters opened their eyes, countless sleeping existences were awakened. They all sensed that power beyond comprehension—the fourth possibility transcending Observer and observed, a realm no one had touched in ten thousand years. And the one who created all this was a disciple everyone had deemed worthless. The chess game of destiny had finally arrived at its most brilliant turning point.
